decisions.reason: The evening psychiatric day-patient program extends a core therapeutic service line and, despite higher specialist staffing costs, remains strategically strong enough to keep while demand and reimbursement continue to stabilize.

Outpatient sociotherapy is very close to the firm's core community-support offer and can be maintained relatively flexibly, so it is sensible to keep this option open as referrals and utilization develop.

After two years the retail shop still looks peripheral to the main care portfolio and more exposed to uncertain consumer demand, so the option value now appears lower than the value of redeploying resources.
Meal delivery for seniors fits the eldercare customer base and is still new enough that its value is not fully revealed, so it is worth retaining for another year despite logistical and margin risks.
